data.title: 猫猫 · 晒架上的最后一缕日光
data.description: 傍晚药房后院，猫猫穿靛蓝工作衣和米色长裙，把空竹筛叠好收进架子。她忽然发现筛边停着一只小瓢虫，便停住手等它爬开，雀斑间的神情从专注变成一点好奇。
data.action: 发现竹筛边的瓢虫后停手，耐心等它爬开。
data.promptProse: Maomao stacks empty bamboo sieves onto the pharmacy courtyard rack, then pauses when a ladybird lands on one rim. Her indigo work jacket and linen waist apron cover a beige long skirt; curiosity replaces concentration between her freckles as she waits. The medium portrait keeps rack slats and courtyard ground visible. Reflected late-afternoon light brightens the insect and woven bamboo, with soft sieve shadows layered against the rack behind.
